1.e4 c6 2.d4 d5 3.e5 Bf5 4.Nc3 e6 5.g4 B.strategy: Develops without blocking the f-pawn and prepares to push the h-pawn at the bishop, while the knight can also head for f4. White commits to the kingside attack and leaves the centre to be defended by pawns.

Strikes at White's centre at once, before the pawn storm bites: a counterattack in the centre is the best answer to a flank attack. White's h-pawn push threatens to trap the bishop, so Black has to play accurately and the game is sharp.
